Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and mild anisocytosis. MCHC is slightly low. Glucose is mildly decreased. Electrolytes, renal and liver function are within normal limits. No evidence of acute infection with SARS-CoV-2. Findings may suggest chronic disease, possible bone marrow suppression, or age-related changes; clinical correlation is recommended.
